title: Crochet Sakura Flower
name: Sakura Flower
seoTitle: Easy Crochet Sakura Flower Pattern (Free PDF)
description: Free, quick crochet sakura (cherry blossom) flower pattern: a chain ring and five dc petals, with a touch of blush in the centre. Printable PDF.
lead: A tiny five-petal cherry blossom made on a chain ring. It takes a few minutes, so make a handful for a hair clip, a card or a garland.

materialsTable.details: Light pink cotton yarn, a few grams
A little pink blush or pink pencil for the centre

notes: The petals are worked into the chain ring, not into stitches.

rounds.text: Make a slip knot. ch 5, sl st into the first ch to make a ring.
ch 6, dc into the ring, ch 1 and sl st through the dc.
Repeat the petal 4 more times. sl st to join and fasten off.

finishing: Add a little blush to the centre.
